integrity: The result is derived from the published MO-Adagrad recurrence and independently replayed by a bundled finite consistency checker. The proof of the quantified statements is analytic; numerical checks are not used as substitutes for proof. Closest adaptive multiobjective and classical steepest-descent sources were compared directly.
scientific_limitations: Scalar deterministic equal-curvature symmetric bi-objective quadratics only; no claim for unequal curvatures, higher-dimensional Pareto manifolds, stochastic gradients, or post-overshoot global dynamics.
title: Sharp one-step Pareto-capture threshold and full-set overshoot for MO-Adagrad on symmetric quadratics
